**SENTINEL AI Building Management Assistant**

I can help you with:

**🔍 Equipment & Health**
• "What's the status of site-002?" - Building overview with alerts
• "Show equipment in warning state" - Filter by health status
• "Check S002-CHILLER-B1-001" - Specific equipment details

**🚨 Alerts & Work Orders**
• "What alerts are active?" - Current warnings and critical issues
• "Create work order for [equipment]" - Generate maintenance requests

**🌡️ HVAC & Comfort**
• "What are the floor temperatures?" - Zone-by-zone readings
• "Too hot at my desk" - Comfort diagnosis with sensor data
• "Set Level 2 to 23 degrees" - Adjust setpoints (operator role required)

**⚡ Energy & Solar**
• "Energy consumption today" - Usage breakdown
• "Solar and battery status" - PV generation and BESS state

**🏢 Occupancy**
• "How busy is the building?" - Real-time occupancy from DALI sensors
• "Level 1 occupancy" - Floor-level detail

**Examples:**
• "What's the current situation with site-002?"
• "Show me equipment with low health scores"
• "Create work order for S002-AHU-R-001 - unusual noise"
• "How busy is Level 2?"
• "Any faulty lights?"

All data is live from Sandton City Office Tower (site-002).

What would you like to know?

I can help you create a work order. To generate one, I need a few details:

**Required Information:**
• Which equipment needs attention? (e.g., "S002-CHILLER-B1-001")
• What's the issue or maintenance needed?
• Priority level? (low/medium/high/critical)

**Example formats:**
• "Create work order for S002-CHILLER-B1-001 - unusual vibration"
• "Work order for S002-AHU-R-001 - high vibration alarm"
• "Urgent work order for S002-GEN-B1-001 - failed start test"

Once you provide these details, I'll generate a work order with:
✅ Unique work order ID
✅ Auto-generated priority based on equipment risk
✅ Site and equipment reference
✅ Creation timestamp

What equipment would you like to create a work order for?
